Crime & Law · India

Delhi protest violence investigated, police action questioned

During protests in Delhi, violence erupted, leading to the firing of tear gas shells. A woman involved in the protests was injured and placed on a ventilator, prompting AIIMS doctors to urge the President to order a probe into police actions. Delhi Police sources indicated that passports of individuals involved in the protest violence might be cancelled. Separately, police are investigating the protest's organization, examining digital trails and alleged blueprints, while also fact-checking viral claims. An injured Delhi Police inspector recounted an attack during the violence.
